reason: The text explicitly demonstrates the importance and establishment of strict hierarchy. It describes clear organizational structure with distinct classes: Nehemiah as supreme leader, then 'nobles' (חֹרִים) and 'rulers' (סְגָנִים) as middle authority, followed by 'the rest of the people' (יֶתֶר הָעָ֔ם). The text repeatedly shows hierarchical command: Nehemiah directly commanding nobles and rulers to rally people, organizing people 'by families' with weapons, positioning 'leaders' (שָׂרִים) 'after each house of Judah,' and establishing a trumpet-based system where people must assemble at the sound of the trumpet—a direct military/organizational hierarchy. The rebuilding project's success explicitly depends on this organized command structure.
